title: PSG4-THIRDBASE: exact leading coefficients with explicit lower-order growth at a lower-source profile

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG4-THIRDBASE program in proof.md recovers the entire s from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. It uses C=4096, k=b+6 on positive-width blocks (unit shortcuts at zero width), beta=21/20 and exact delta(v)=min{d>=0:20*2^d>=21*(2v+6)}, with the changed actual threshold u=max(1,floor(R/3)) and the first-feasible R. All root bounds, decoder parameters, source precision and literal acquisition/weighted caps are recomputed. Jointly on EVERY execution branch, including failures, retries, wrong extracted labels and cutoff aborts, total paid work T is O(2^((3/4)sqrt(n log2 n)+sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-1/4))) with exact growth index 1/2. Outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. These are full exact supported Big-O envelopes, including the positive lower-order term for time and samples, not pure leading exponent claims. The finite branch covers all smaller inputs; the eventual-positive representatives extend over the finite prefix. All resources and clean fraction0 hold for this same configuration.

For the same PSG4-THIRDBASE algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
